name: Walnut panel ready dishwasher 24in

placement.allowed_scaling: Rigid translation/rotation only; no appliance scaling

installation.mounting: Level floor, host anti-tip restraint and selected manufacturer installation required
installation.opening_note: Clear opening excludes projecting pulls; actual selected product determines gaps and ventilation.
installation.countertop_note: Counter underside at least .875m concept height; countertop spans opening with support supplied by host. No cabinet carcass or drawer front occupies this bay.

operating_envelope.modeled_state: Closed integrated drop-down door; hidden top-edge controls
operating_envelope.motion: Bottom hinged panel, 90-degree opening, approximately 0.759m leaf length.
operating_envelope.basis: Conservative rounded concept envelope includes handle and door thickness; actual hinge/slide mechanism unselected.

services: Adjacent sink water, drain and electrical service; access without trapping hoses or blocking toe-kick removal.

derived_from.basis: Identical measured native geometry, interfaces and hardware; wood changed to linked warm-walnut/v001 with physical-meter grain UVs.

rights: Original concept geometry and materials by Homes project contributors; retain attribution. No manufacturer model or certified installation claim.
limitations: Original visualization appliance, closed-state modeled only. Operating envelopes are concept allowances, not manufacturer or code approval; host must verify actual open state and services.

host_integration.required: Adopting home must check installation, service space and operating envelopes.
